name: PostgreSQL extras
description: Three PostgreSQL extensions Coditect does not bundle. An example of the pack format; see docs/EXTENSION_PACK_FORMAT.md.

extensions.name: pgroonga
extensions.label: PGroonga
extensions.summary: Full-text search over any language, including CJK, where the built-in text search needs a per-language configuration.

types.name: pgroonga_full_text_search_condition
types.summary: A search condition passed to the &@~ operator.

functions.name: pgroonga_score
functions.summary: Relevance of the current row; the usual ORDER BY key.

extensions.note: The index method is named after the extension: USING pgroonga, not USING gin.

extensions.name: pg_partman
extensions.label: pg_partman
extensions.summary: Creates and retires time- or serial-based partitions on a schedule, so a big table does not need a hand-written partition per month.

functions.name: create_parent
functions.summary: Run once per table, after the partitioned CREATE TABLE.

functions.name: run_maintenance
functions.summary: Makes the next partitions and drops expired ones; run it from a scheduler.

extensions.note: Wants its own schema, and a background worker or cron job to call run_maintenance(). The partitions themselves are ordinary tables and the diagram will only ever show the parent.

extensions.name: temporal_tables
extensions.label: temporal_tables
extensions.summary: System-versioned tables: a trigger copies each superseded row into a history table with the period it was valid for.

types.name: tstzrange
types.summary: The validity period column. Built into PostgreSQL; listed here because the trigger requires one.

functions.name: versioning
functions.summary: The trigger function, attached BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE.

extensions.note: Model the history table as a real table and the copying as a data-flow connection from the versioned table to it.
